title: ci(ui-merge): port objectui's lockfile-integrity gate into Type Check UI and retire lockfile-dedupe and the shadcn-check report
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi953MBpM3iLJAsd1HJwbM7eJ)_

Part of #26717 (slice 2: roster rows 19, 18 and 26 land here; row 7-docs stays open on the card for the seat's decision, see Acceptance notes. Row 17 is out of scope by #25914's ruling.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectui 剩下的三个"移植或退役"检查处理完。锁文件重复检查(lockfile-integrity)接进根 CI 的 `Type Check UI`,只在 PR 上跑,发现问题只打一条报错注释,不挡合并,和 objectui 当年一样。另外两个退役:锁文件 dedupe 报告(90 天 145 次运行从未失败)和 shadcn 每周报告的分类脚本,连同它们的测试一起删掉。
- 为什么改:objectui 并入后这些检查没有在任何地方运行;要么接回来,要么明确删掉,不留半死的脚本。
- 风险与回滚:`Type Check UI` 是必需检查,但新步骤带 `continue-on-error`,它红了不会让这个 job 红,所以不会挡任何 PR。删掉的脚本没有别的读者。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 里 `Type Check UI` 新加的 `check:lockfile-integrity` 步骤;`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts` 新加的四条接线测试。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui run check:lockfile-integrity --base-ref origin/main`,预期 `VERDICT clean — no package gained a copy.`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 改了 `ci.yml`(Tier H),需要你明确批准;另外第 7-docs 行(objectui 文档站构建)记录里没定,席位会把选项拿给你。

## What changes

Rows of the #25697 workflow roster (comment 6388182608), read from the objectui workflows #26058 deleted (`lockfile-integrity.yml`, `lockfile-dedupe.yml`, `shadcn-check.yml` at `aa2f8e31f3`'s parent).

| Row | objectui workflow | Disposition here |
|---|---|---|
| 19 | `lockfile-integrity.yml` (`check:lockfile-integrity`) | **ported**: one step of `Type Check UI`, `check:lockfile-integrity — compare this pull request's lockfile with its merge base` |
| 18 | `lockfile-dedupe.yml` (`check:lockfile-dedupe`, report-only since objectui#9562's ruling A) | **retired**: alias, `ui/scripts/check-lockfile-dedupe.mjs` and its test deleted; nothing replaces it, by choice (#25920: 145 runs / 90 days / 0 failures) |
| 26 | `shadcn-check.yml` (weekly report) | **retired**: `ui/scripts/shadcn-check-report.mjs` (the workflow's classifier and issue-body renderer) and its test deleted; nothing replaces the weekly report, by choice |

- **Row 19, the step.** `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, `continue-on-error: true`, before `pnpm install`, running `pnpm --dir ui run check:lockfile-integrity --base-ref "origin/${BASE_REF}"` with `BASE_REF` from `github.base_ref`. Why this job: it already checks out with `fetch-depth: 0`, so `origin/BASE` and the merge base are in the clone (objectui paid a separate job for that history), and the `ui` paths filter lists `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so every lockfile change runs it. Before the install because the script needs only Node builtins and two repo modules, as objectui ran it; Lint UI's pre-install import graph check holds that. `continue-on-error` keeps objectui's classification: a finding prints `::error title=Lockfile integrity::PACKAGES` on the pull request and does not fail the required job. Making it blocking stays the maintainer's call (`NOT_A_GATE` in `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`). No new job, no new check-run context, no new required context.
- **Row 26, what stays.** `shadcn:check` and `shadcn:analyze` (and `shadcn-sync.js`, `shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, `component-analysis.js`) are not retired: they are the components package's maintainer commands, read by `ui/packages/components/README.md`, `README_SHADCN_SYNC.md`, `shadcn-components.json`, the other four `shadcn:*` aliases and `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`. The weekly workflow only scheduled them; its own artifact was the classifier, and that is what goes. The two ui tests that read `shadcn-sync` (`shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`, `shadcn-sync-fetch-cache.test.ts`) test those live scripts and stay.

### Forced test edits

- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts`: the note saying the port would "bring both pins back against the root job" is replaced by those pins, read from root `ci.yml` through `helpers/root-ci`: the step exists and runs the gate against the pull request base; the job checks out with `fetch-depth: 0` before it; the step is `continue-on-error` and before the install; no other root workflow carries the alias. 13 → 17 cases.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-dedupe.test.ts` and `ui/scripts/__tests__/shadcn-check-report.test.ts`: deleted with the scripts they test.

## Tests

Measured in this worktree on head `a463a624`.

<details><summary>Row 19: the step's command, and its counter-probe</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui run check:lockfile-integrity --base-ref origin/main` (the step's `run:` with `BASE_REF=main`): exit 0, `base: 7bb80845…:pnpm-lock.yaml (1941 resolutions)  head: …/pnpm-lock.yaml (1941 resolutions)`, `VERDICT clean — no package gained a copy.`
- Counter-probe: the root `pnpm-lock.yaml` mutated with the test's sample (a) (a second `ai@7.0.65(zod@4.6.7)` snapshot beside `ai@7.0.118(zod@4.6.7)`; marker count 1 on disk), then the same command: exit 1, `VERDICT 1 lockfile-integrity finding(s): 1 duplication(s).` and `::error title=Lockfile integrity::ai — see the run log; this is a lockfile regression, not a bundle regression (objectui#8326).` Restored by `git checkout HEAD -- pnpm-lock.yaml` under a trap; blob `8b64d515` before and after; `git diff HEAD` empty; re-run exit 0, `VERDICT clean`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts`: 17 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Rows 18 and 26: every reader gone</summary>

- `git grep -n -F check:lockfile-dedupe`: no hits (exit 1).
- `git grep -n -F shadcn-check-report -- ':!ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md' ':!ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs'`: no hits. The two remaining mentions are prose about objectui's deleted workflows (Acceptance notes).
- `git grep -n -F check-lockfile-dedupe -- ':!ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md' ':!ui/scripts/workspace-root.mjs'`: no hits. Same reason.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 7-docs (`@object-ui/site`, objectui `ci.yml` "Build Docs") is not decided here.** The card says to decide it with F14 / docs-deploy (sub-issue 4 row 10). Read: #25712's item 5 says objectui's `docs-deploy.yml` should become "a second deploy job in this repo's `docs-deploy.yml` (the site stays a separate Vercel project) — the project id/secrets are the maintainer's"; #26058 then deleted it with "(none; objectui's site is a separate Vercel project)", and root `docs-deploy.yml` deploys `apps/docs` only. F14 (now on #25753) is the rewrite of `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, not a build decision. So the record decides the deploy, which never landed, and not the per-PR build row. The options go to the seat in the card report; the card stays open (`Part of`).
- `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` (F14, #25753) still describes `lockfile-integrity.yml`, `lockfile-dedupe.yml` and `shadcn-check.yml` as live, as it does every other deleted objectui workflow. Outside this card's file surface; F14 rewrites it.
- `ui/scripts/workspace-root.mjs`'s docblock still names `check-lockfile-dedupe.mjs` as one of two pre-install importers, and `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` still classifies `Lockfile Dedupe Check` (`OPTIONAL_CONTEXTS`) and names `shadcn-check-report.mjs` in its header. Prose and context names from objectui's CI, outside the surface; `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` runs in no root workflow.
- The card delta named `dispatch-gates --tier` MANDATORY for `ci.yml`; measured on this change set it reports no path-derived mandate (`the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)`).

## Verification

Final head `a463a624`, after a root `pnpm build` (VERDICT command-exit 0, 12m30s under `os-verify-lock`).

<details><summary>Gate sweep and reconciliation</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 74 commands for this change set (7 paths, 2175 changed lines). All 74 ran and exited 0, each exit code captured before any pipe. Among them: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under `os-verify-lock` (176 files passed, 2 skipped; 5032 tests passed, 2 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0), `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1935 cases), `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity`, `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips`, `pnpm check:workflow-step-name-quoting` and `pnpm check:published-files`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran LEDGER`: `✓ 74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, 0 UNRUN.
- `origin/main` moved 11 commits after the base `7bb80845`; none touches this PR's files, so it is not merged in.

- Not run locally: `pnpm lint` and the full test suites, which are CI's run.

</details>
